audit_kind: source and preserved pinned-original instruction evidence; no build/device/engine runtime tests

original_alias.semantics: [field]=*(blocks[(offset-1)>>29].data+((offset-1)&0x1fffffff)); no TEMP scope/generation test; block0 is permitted. Actual caller source references this leaf at0x604f83 before any new TEMP overwrite.

feasibility: Opaque native-value retention is sufficient for a registered complete4-byte logical pointer word that is logically untouched but whose native pointer slot is physically overwritten. It is not general TEMP object lifetime or arbitrary offset reconstruction.

confirmed_source_references.registration: src/database/db_expand.cpp:145-152 (one production callsite; raw tag widened before child fixups)

expander_source_scan.scan_method: anchored function signature and brace-depth scan plus selected manual body inspection; staging dst is not native destination

minimal_plan: Keep original Win32 branch and disk ABI unchanged. Limit first native TEMP policy to typed registered whole-pointer aliases.
Represent latest coordinate authority as LiveSlot, RetainedValue, or Unsupported/Tombstone, with explicit found-status; valid null is found value0.

At successful staging-read/pre-native-store boundary capture current native words from checked live TEMP slots using memcpy, not initially registered raw tags. Previously retained words remain retained without rereading stale slots.

Skip side envelope and zero-byte/nonwrite paths; snapshot all eligible block0 live records if native footprint is not yet known. Include separate direct Load_Stream and Load_XStringCustom write transactions or explicitly reject unsupported TEMP writers before stores.

At Commit compare old logical4-byte intervals and native sizeof(uintptr_t) intervals against actual successful write. Logical overlap invalidates old records; full logical untouched/native overlap retains captured value; both untouched stays live. New generation registrations supersede old equal-coordinate records.

Resolution of retained word returns stored opaque value directly without pretending metadata is an XBlock slot. No recursive tag conversion, pointer-high-bit guess, low-address assumption, or null-as-missing fallback.
Unsupported historical coordinates must stop Alias/Exact/Drift fallback. TEMP address conversion and unregistered/interior alias coordinates remain a separate checked boundary.
Pop only restores cursors; it does not expire records. Init/reset/detach clears pending capture/value/tombstone lifetime and ownership.

Reserve all capture/publication capacity before native stores; no postwrite metadata allocation failure is certified. Abort/shortread handling must discard the zone or implement real partial-write validity, never resume with stale live slots.
risks: Original alias copies current logical word, which may be null, unresolved sentinel/offset, interned ID, or pointer. Preserve opaque native bits; numeric classification is not reliable.
Partial logical overwrite produces a mixed Win32 word. Typed value policy cannot reconstruct that generally; report explicit unsupported until proved reconstruction exists.
Retaining pointer value does not retain pointed-to TEMP object bytes; persistent block4 child ownership is certified separately.
Native capture must occur before full native memset, including tail/padding. Commit alone is too late.
Common file-reader dst is staging buffer; converter registrations occur before Commit, requiring old/new generation separation.
Direct Load_Stream writes native memory and commits; null-terminated reader writes most bytes without DB_LoadXFileData. Generic reader-only hook is incomplete.
Production direct reader may write partial bytes before fatal/read failure; successful-only rollback cannot claim byte-level atomicity.
External envelope side aliases have logical block0 keys but point outside block0; distinguish them rather than range-capturing arbitrary external memory.
Cursor rewind yields out-of-order segments/drift marks; exact/drift address fallbacks can select stale physically overwritten mappings.
Delayed streams2/3 are written later; DB_InsertPointer is reservation plus later explicit publication, not an immediate data write.
A retained record cannot track later assignments made through a stale native pointer. Such a caller needs authoritative update routing or an explicit unsupported guard.
Global loader state is serial; retain that contract and reset generation state between zones rather than infer concurrent safety.
Validated directory/script/first StringTable metadata contains zero encoded-block0 references; unseen asset bodies remain unaudited.
acceptance_cases: Old StringTable logical values12/current native16 persistent child4 pointer survives RawFile disk12/native24 physical overwrite.
Live cellIndex logical16/native24 survives untouched; new RawFile name0 and buffer8 aliases supersede old logical overlaps.
Null, sign-extended inline sentinels, ordinary offset word, pool pointer and native address aboveu32 retain exact current bits with explicit found status.
No-write Pop, nested Push0/Pop0 and repeated differently sized writes retain logical tail semantics and newest typed coordinate authority.
Partial logical overlap, unknown alias coordinate, stale address fallback, range/overflow/misalignment and unsupported prewrite writer reject explicitly.
Array full transaction snapshots before full memset; replacement records stay authoritative after Commit; failed staging read leaves both cursors and aliases unchanged.
Direct TEMP scalar/byte and null-terminated writes are hooked or blocked before mutation; reservation-only Inc does not count as data write.
Init/reset clears retained authority and counters; envelope side aliases/block4 persistent children stay separately owned; full existing owner regressions remain exact.
